info.name: Hotel Platform API
info.description: API tests for the Hotel Booking Platform (all requests go through the Nginx API gateway). Select the 'Hotel Platform - Local' environment. Cookies are handled automatically. Log in as the matching role before role-specific requests.

item.name: 01 Auth

request.description: Login as guest first. A fresh Idempotency-Key (UUID) is generated for every send.
The pre-request script signs the raw body with HMAC-SHA256 using webhook_secret and adds x-signature.
Run as the guest who created the booking.
